items.title: George "Happy" Schilling Interview, 1957-09-08
items.q: That boy couldn't read music, couldn't they? Teaching me music right now with Lawrence Welk.

ctx.x: Pete Fontaine. That boy couldn't read music, couldn't they? Teaching me music right now with Lawrence Welk. He can't sit in the men no more than me. That's out of his class altogether. He's a good clown at man in his own category. But when he gets in to play with the other guys, there's a difference in life and day. You know that. He's a good clown at play. But there's some men in Lawrence Welk's band could play just as good as him. They got him up there for a purpose. They got him only for recording. To make…
There's one other question and we don't want to keep you very late. Then you're just about out of tape. Did you ever play any funerals? Oh, yes.
